Validate, install, inspect, and run CLI-only script plugins

Usage: treer plugin <COMMAND>

Commands:
  validate   Validate a plugin package without executing it
  install    Install an immutable plugin package without executing it
  list       List installed plugin versions
  inspect    Inspect the selected installed version of a plugin
  uninstall  Uninstall every local package version after revoking Core sessions
  run        Run a plugin in the foreground through a command-limited broker
  auth       Manage a broker-bound human session for this plugin
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
